title: Density Formula
text: Density is mass per unit volume: $$\rho=\frac{m}{V}, $$ where $$\rho$$ is the density, $$m$$ is the mass, and $$V$$ is the volume occupied by the substance.

title: Identify the Density of Coffee
text: Since coffee is assumed to have the same density as water, use $$\rho=1.00\,\text{g/cm}**3$$.

title: Use the Volume Formula for a Cylinder
text: Remember that the volume of a cylinder is $$V=\pi{}r**2h$$.
